summary: A man must have a clear mind when he tells people to write a get. If he cannot speak, they test him with questions to see that he understands.

chunks.en: Someone who was struck by a sickness that confuses the mind,
chunks.st: In the case of one who was afflicted with temporary insanity [kordeyakos]

words.note: A sickness that makes a person confused for a while.

chunks.en: and said, "Write a get for my wife,"
chunks.st: and said: Write a bill of divorce for my wife,

chunks.en: did not say anything.
chunks.st: he said nothing,
chunks.stMore: because he was not lucid at the time.

chunks.en: If he said, "Write a get for my wife,"
chunks.st: If he said: Write a bill of divorce for my wife, when he was lucid,

chunks.en: and then the confusing sickness struck him,
chunks.st: and was then afflicted with temporary insanity

chunks.en: and he changed his mind and said,
chunks.st: and he retracted his previous statement and said:

chunks.en: "Do not write,"
chunks.st: Do not write it,

chunks.en: his last words do not count at all.
chunks.st: his latter statement is considered to be nothing, i.e., it is not halakhically valid.
chunks.stMore: The mishna continues:

chunks.he: נִשְׁתַּתֵּק, וְאָמְרוּ לוֹ נִכְתֹּב גֵּט לְאִשְׁתֶּךָ,
chunks.en: If he could not speak, and they said to him, "Shall we write a get for your wife?"
chunks.st: In a case where the husband became mute, and two people said to him: Shall we write a bill of divorce for your wife,

chunks.en: and he nodded his head,
chunks.st: and he nodded his head indicating his agreement,

chunks.en: they test him three times.
chunks.st: they examine him with various questions three times.

chunks.en: If to a "no" question he answered
chunks.st: If he responded to questions that have a negative answer:

chunks.en: "no," and to a "yes" question "yes,"
chunks.st: No, and responded to questions that have a positive answer: Yes, indicating his competence,

chunks.en: they should write it and give it.
chunks.st: they shall write the bill of divorce and give it to his wife based on the nod of his head.

summary: For a get, the husband himself must tell the scribe to write and the witnesses to sign. It is not enough for others to tell them.

chunks.en: If they said to him,
chunks.st: If people said to the husband:

chunks.en: "Shall we write a get for your wife?"
chunks.st: Shall we write a bill of divorce for your wife?

chunks.en: and he said to them, "Write,"
chunks.st: And he said to them: Write the document,
chunks.stMore: and those people

chunks.en: and they told the scribe and he wrote,
chunks.st: told the scribe to write it, and he wrote it

chunks.en: and the witnesses, and they signed,
chunks.st: and instructed the witnesses to sign it, and they signed it;

chunks.en: even though they wrote it and signed it,
chunks.st: even if they wrote it, and signed it,

chunks.en: and gave it to him and he then gave it to her,
chunks.st: and gave it to him, and he then gave it to his wife,

chunks.en: the get is cancelled,
chunks.st: the bill of divorce is void

chunks.he: עַד שֶׁיֹּאמַר לַסּוֹפֵר כְּתֹב וְלָעֵדִים חֲתֹמוּ:
chunks.en: until he himself says to the scribe "Write," and to the witnesses "Sign."
chunks.st: unless he himself says to the scribe: Write the document, and he himself says to the witnesses: Sign the document.

summary: A get cannot start working after the husband dies. So the exact words he says, like "from today," decide whether the get counts.

chunks.en: "This is your get if I die,"
chunks.st: If one says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce if I die,

chunks.he: זֶה גִטֵּךְ אִם מַתִּי מֵחֹלִי זֶה,
chunks.en: "This is your get if I die from this sickness,"
chunks.st: or: This is your bill of divorce if I die from this illness,

chunks.en: "This is your get after death,"
chunks.st: or: This is your bill of divorce after my death,

chunks.en: he did not say anything.
chunks.st: then it is as if he said nothing,
chunks.stMore: since a bill of divorce is valid only if it takes effect before the husband’s death.

chunks.en: "From today, if I die,"
chunks.st: But if the husband said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce from today if I die,

chunks.en: "From now, if I die,"
chunks.st: or: This is your bill of divorce from now if I die,

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: then this is a valid bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: because once he dies, the bill of divorce retroactively applies from when he made this statement.

chunks.en: "From today and after death,"
chunks.st: If the husband says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce from today and after my death,

chunks.en: it is a get and not a get.
chunks.explain: We do not know which he meant.
chunks.st: then it is uncertain whether his primary intention was for the bill of divorce to take effect that day, in which case it is a valid bill of divorce, or if his primary intention was that it should take effect after his death and is therefore not valid. The halakha is that there is uncertainty whether it is a valid bill of divorce or not a valid bill of divorce.

chunks.en: If he dies,
chunks.st: And if he dies

chunks.en: she does chalitzah and not yibum.
chunks.explain: If he had no children, his brother must free her with chalitzah.
chunks.st: without children his wife must perform ḥalitza,
chunks.stMore: since perhaps the bill of divorce is not valid and she is bound by the levirate bond and may not remarry without first performing ḥalitza.

chunks.en: "This is your get from today if
chunks.st: But she may not enter into levirate marriage, since perhaps the bill of divorce is valid, and it is prohibited for a divorcée to marry her brother-in-law. If he said: This is your bill of divorce from today if

chunks.en: I die from this sickness,"
chunks.st: I die from this illness,

chunks.en: and he got up and walked in the market, then got sick and died,
chunks.st: and he recovered, and he arose and walked in the market, but then became ill again and died,

chunks.en: we judge him.
chunks.st: the court assesses him.

chunks.en: If he died because of the first sickness,
chunks.st: If he died because of the first illness

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: then this is a valid bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: as his conditional statement was fulfilled,

chunks.en: And if not,
chunks.st: but if not,

chunks.en: it is not a get.
chunks.st: i.e., if he was cured from the first illness and died from another illness, then it is not a valid bill of divorce.

summary: While a sick husband's get is waiting to take effect, his wife may not be alone with him. The Rabbis argue whether she counts as married or divorced in those days.

chunks.he: לֹא תִתְיַחֵד עִמּוֹ אֶלָּא בִפְנֵי עֵדִים,
chunks.en: She may not be alone with him unless witnesses are there,
chunks.st: If a woman’s ill husband gave her a bill of divorce, and made a condition that it should take effect from today if he dies from his illness, then she may be secluded with him only in the presence of two witnesses,
chunks.stMore: lest they end up engaging in sexual intercourse. This applies to being secluded in the presence of not only valid witnesses; it is permitted for her to be secluded with him

chunks.en: even a slave,
chunks.st: even in the presence of a slave

chunks.en: even a maidservant,
chunks.st: or even in the presence of a maidservant,

chunks.en: except her own maidservant,
chunks.st: except for the wife’s personal maidservant.
chunks.stMore: And it is prohibited for the wife to be secluded in the presence of the latter

chunks.en: because she is very used to her own maidservant.
chunks.st: because she is accustomed to her maidservant,
chunks.stMore: and there is concern that she will engage in sexual intercourse with her husband even though the maidservant is present.

chunks.en: What is she during those days?
chunks.st: What is the halakhic status of the wife during these days
chunks.stMore: between when the bill of divorce was given but before the condition has been fulfilled with the death of the husband?

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehuda says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda says:

chunks.en: she is like a married woman in every way.
chunks.st: She is like a married woman with regard to all of her matters,
chunks.stMore: and she remains forbidden to other men.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yosei says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yosei says:

chunks.en: she is divorced and not divorced.
chunks.st: It is uncertain whether she is divorced or whether she is not divorced.

summary: A husband may give a get on condition that his wife pays him something. If she lost the coat he asked for, she may pay its value instead.

chunks.en: "This is your get on condition
chunks.st: If a husband says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce on the condition

chunks.en: that you give me two hundred zuz,"
chunks.st: that you will give me two hundred dinars,

words.note: A zuz is a silver coin.

chunks.en: she is divorced,
chunks.st: then she is divorced

chunks.en: and she must give it. "On condition that you give me
chunks.st: and must give two hundred dinars in order to fulfill the condition of the bill of divorce. If a husband says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce on the condition that you will give me

chunks.en: from now until thirty days,"
chunks.st: money from now until the conclusion of thirty days,

chunks.he: אִם נָתְנָה לוֹ בְתוֹךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם,
chunks.en: if she gave it to him within thirty days,
chunks.st: if she gives the money to him within thirty days

chunks.en: she is divorced. And if not,
chunks.st: she is divorced. And if not

chunks.en: she is not divorced.
chunks.st: she is not divorced.

chunks.en: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said,
chunks.st: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said:

chunks.en: once in Tzaidan, a man said to his wife,
chunks.st: There was an incident in the city of Tzaidan involving one who said to his wife:

chunks.en: "This is your get on
chunks.st: This is your bill of divorce on

chunks.en: condition that you give me my coat,"
chunks.st: the condition that you will give me my coat [itztaliti],

chunks.en: and his coat got lost,
chunks.st: and she lost his coat,
chunks.stMore: so that she could not give it to him.

chunks.en: and the Sages said,
chunks.st: And the Rabbis said that

chunks.en: she should give him its value.
chunks.st: she must give him the value of the coat, and by doing so she fulfills the condition and is divorced.

summary: A get may be given on condition that the wife helps his father or feeds his baby. If the condition cannot be kept and it is not her fault, Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says the get still counts.

chunks.en: "This is your get on
chunks.st: If a husband says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce on

chunks.en: condition that you serve my father,"
chunks.st: the condition that you will serve my father,

chunks.en: or "on condition that you nurse my son,"
chunks.st: or: On the condition that you will nurse, i.e., breastfeed, my son,
chunks.stMore: without specifying a time period,

chunks.en: how long must she nurse him?
chunks.st: how long is she required to nurse him
chunks.stMore: in order to fulfill the condition?

chunks.en: Two years.
chunks.st: She is required to nurse the baby for two years
chunks.stMore: from his birth, which is the length of time generally designated for nursing.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehuda says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda says:

chunks.en: eighteen months.
chunks.st: The time for nursing is only eighteen months.

chunks.en: If the son died or the father died,
chunks.st: If the baby son died or the husband’s father died,

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: this is a valid bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: even though the condition was not fulfilled.

chunks.en: "This is your get on condition
chunks.st: But if the husband said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce on the condition

chunks.en: that you serve my father for two years,"
chunks.st: that you will serve my father for two years,

chunks.en: or "on condition that you nurse
chunks.st: or: On the condition that you will nurse

chunks.en: my son for two years,"
chunks.st: my son for two years,

chunks.he: מֵת הַבֵּן אוֹ שֶׁמֵּת הָאָב אוֹ
chunks.en: if the son died, or the father died, or
chunks.st: and the son died before she nursed him for two years, or

chunks.en: the father said, "I do not want you to serve me,"
chunks.st: the father said: I do not want you to serve me,
chunks.stMore: then even if the father

chunks.en: even if he was not angry,
chunks.st: did not say this in anger
chunks.stMore: and she did everything she was expected to do,

chunks.en: it is not a get.
chunks.st: it is not a valid bill of divorce
chunks.stMore: because the condition was not fulfilled.

chunks.en: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says,
chunks.st: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:

chunks.en: a case like this is a get.
chunks.st: In a case like this it is a valid bill of divorce.

chunks.he: כְּלָל אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל,
chunks.en: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said a rule:
chunks.st: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel stated a principle:

chunks.en: anything that stops her that is not her fault,
chunks.st: If there is any hindrance to the fulfillment of the condition that does not result from her,

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: then it is a valid bill of divorce.

summary: If a man says the get works if he does not come back in thirty days, and he comes back in time, the condition is over. If he said "thirty days away from you," coming and going does not stop it.

chunks.en: "This is your get if I do not
chunks.st: If a resident of the region of Judea intending to embark on a journey to the Galilee said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce if I do not

chunks.en: come back from now until thirty days,"
chunks.st: come back from now until the conclusion of thirty days,

chunks.en: and he was going from Yehudah to the Galil,
chunks.st: and when he was going from Judea to the Galilee

chunks.en: and he reached Antipatris and came back,
chunks.st: he reached Antipatris and he returned immediately,

words.note: A town on the way from Yehudah to the Galil.

chunks.en: his condition is cancelled.
chunks.st: his condition is void
chunks.stMore: and his wife is not divorced, even if he subsequently returns to the Galilee for longer than thirty days. The reason for this is because he reached the Galilee and returned to Judea within the time he had allotted.

chunks.en: "This is your get if I do not
chunks.st: Similarly, if a resident of the region of the Galilee intending to embark on a journey to Judea said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce if I do not

chunks.en: come back from now until thirty days,"
chunks.st: come back from now until the conclusion of thirty days,

chunks.en: and he was going from the Galil to Yehudah,
chunks.st: and he was going from the Galilee to Judea,

chunks.en: and he reached Kefar Otnai and came back,
chunks.st: and he reached Kefar Otnai and returned immediately,

chunks.en: his condition is cancelled.
chunks.st: his condition is void
chunks.stMore: and his wife is not divorced, even if he subsequently returns to Judea for longer than thirty days.

chunks.en: "This is your get if I do not
chunks.st: Similarly, if a resident of Eretz Yisrael intending to embark on a journey to a country overseas said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce if I do not

chunks.en: come back from now until thirty days,"
chunks.st: come back from now until the conclusion of thirty days,

chunks.en: and he was going overseas,
chunks.st: and he was going to a country overseas,

chunks.en: and he reached Akko and came back,
chunks.st: and he reached Akko and returned immediately,

chunks.en: his condition is cancelled.
chunks.st: his condition is void
chunks.stMore: and his wife is not divorced, even if he subsequently travels to a country overseas for longer than thirty days.

chunks.en: "This is your get whenever
chunks.st: If a husband said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce

chunks.en: I am away from you for thirty days,"
chunks.st: if at any time I will depart from your presence for thirty consecutive days,

chunks.en: even if he was going and coming,
chunks.st: then even if he was continually going and coming,

chunks.en: going and coming,
chunks.st: going and coming,

chunks.en: since he was not alone with her,
chunks.st: since he was not secluded with her during these thirty days,

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: this is a valid bill of divorce.

summary: A get cannot work after the husband dies. But if he said "from now," it starts at once when the condition comes true.

chunks.he: הֲרֵי זֶה גִטֵּךְ אִם לֹא בָאתִי
chunks.en: "This is your get if I do not come
chunks.st: If a husband says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce if I do not come

chunks.en: back from now until twelve months,"
chunks.st: back from now until the conclusion of twelve months,

chunks.en: and he died within twelve months,
chunks.st: and he died within twelve months,

chunks.en: it is not a get.
chunks.st: it is not a valid bill of divorce.
chunks.stMore: This is because the bill of divorce cannot take effect after the husband’s death. As a result, she is bound by a levirate bond if her husband has no children.

chunks.he: הֲרֵי זֶה גִטֵּךְ מֵעַכְשָׁיו אִם לֹא
chunks.en: "This is your get from now if I do not
chunks.st: By contrast, if he said to her: This is your bill of divorce from now if I do not

chunks.he: בָאתִי מִכָּאן וְעַד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ,
chunks.en: come back from now until twelve months,"
chunks.st: come back from now until the conclusion of twelve months,

chunks.en: and he died within twelve months,
chunks.st: and he died within twelve months,

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: this is a valid bill of divorce. This is because the bill of divorce takes effect retroactively. Since he did not return within the year the condition was fulfilled.

summary: A man told others to write and give a get if he does not come back in twelve months. The mishnah tells when the get counts, depending on when they wrote it and gave it.

chunks.he: אִם לֹא בָאתִי מִכָּאן עַד שְׁנֵים
chunks.en: "If I do not come back from now until twelve
chunks.st: If a husband said to others: If I do not come back from now until

chunks.he: עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ כִּתְבוּ וּתְנוּ גֵט לְאִשְׁתִּי,
chunks.en: months, write and give a get to my wife,"
chunks.st: the conclusion of twelve months, write and give a bill of divorce to my wife,

chunks.he: כָּתְבוּ גֵט בְּתוֹךְ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ
chunks.en: if they wrote the get within twelve months
chunks.st: and they wrote a bill of divorce during the twelve months

chunks.en: and gave it after twelve months,
chunks.st: and gave it to her after twelve months had elapsed,

chunks.en: it is not a get.
chunks.st: it is not a valid bill of divorce
chunks.stMore: because he instructed them to write the bill of divorce only after twelve months had elapsed. Similarly, if he said to others:

chunks.he: כִּתְבוּ וּתְנוּ גֵט לְאִשְׁתִּי אִם לֹא
chunks.en: "Write and give a get to my wife if I do not
chunks.st: Write and give a bill of divorce to my wife if I do not

chunks.he: בָאתִי מִכָּאן וְעַד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ,
chunks.en: come back from now until twelve months,"
chunks.st: come back from now until the conclusion of twelve months,

chunks.en: if they wrote it within twelve months
chunks.st: and they wrote it during the twelve months

chunks.en: and gave it after twelve months,
chunks.st: but gave it to her after the twelve months,

chunks.en: it is not a get.
chunks.st: it is not a valid bill of divorce
chunks.stMore: because he instructed them to write the bill of divorce only after twelve months had elapsed, when it was clear that he did not come back.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yosei says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yosei disagrees and says:

chunks.en: a case like this is a get.
chunks.st: In a case like this, it is a valid bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: as he did not tell them when to write the bill of divorce. Rather, he stipulated only the time of giving.

chunks.he: כָּתְבוּ לְאַחַר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ וְנָתְנוּ
chunks.en: If they wrote it after twelve months and gave it
chunks.st: If they wrote the bill of divorce after twelve months had elapsed, and gave it

chunks.st: after twelve months had elapsed, but in the interim the husband died,

chunks.en: if the get came before the death,
chunks.st: if the giving of the bill of divorce occurred before the husband’s death

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: this is a valid bill of divorce.

chunks.en: And if the death came before the get,
chunks.st: But if the husband’s death occurred before the giving of the bill of divorce

chunks.en: And if nobody knows,

chunks.st: this is a case where the Sages said
